entries.heading: ELIMINATION OF CAP ON COMMISSIONED CORPS
ancestors: Subtitle C—Increasing the Supply of the Health Care Workforce
entries.text:
SEC. 5209. ELIMINATION OF CAP ON 
            COMMISSIONED CORPS.

    Section 202 of the Department of Health and Human Services 
Appropriations Act, 1993 (Public Law 102-394) is amended by striking 
``not to exceed 2,800''.

[[Page 124 STAT. 614]]
